# WhatsHide - WhatsApp Web Privacy Shield

> WhatsHide is a zero-latency, 100% client-side Chrome and Chromium extension that shields WhatsApp Web conversations, contact identities, profile avatars (including story/status rings), and sensitive data from visual snooping, shoulder surfing, and physical surveillance.

## Overview & Architecture
WhatsHide operates strictly via local CSS rendering and in-browser DOM manipulation. It guarantees 0 bytes of external data transmission, fully verifiable via the browser Network tab (F12). It is GDPR compliant, requires NO high-risk permissions (zero tabs permission), and adheres to Google Limited Use requirements.

- **Product Category**: Browser Security & Privacy Extension
- **Supported Browsers**: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, Comet, Vivaldi
- **Target Platform**: WhatsApp Web (`https://web.whatsapp.com`)
- **Version**: 6.9.1
- **Pricing**: $2.49 USD (50% Launch Deal with code LAUNCH50) / $4.99 USD regular lifetime access

## Core Capabilities
- **Visual Blur Protection**: Configurable hardware-accelerated CSS blur on sidebar messages, inner conversation bubbles, contact names, media previews (images, videos, audio notes), and unsent drafting input.
- **Universal Avatar Masking**: Blurs standard contact avatars as well as contacts with active WhatsApp story/status rings and SVG circular progress indicators.
- **Instant Stealth Panic Mode**: Instant redirection/camouflage upon pressing `Alt+X` (Knowledge Search Hub), `Alt+E` (Financial Spreadsheet), or `Alt+C` (Developer IDE). Changes tab title, favicon, and screen overlay using self-contained inline SVGs with zero CSP violations.
- **Smart Words & Financial Data Redaction**: Automatic real-time regex redaction for phone numbers, email addresses, credit cards, IBANs, national IDs, and user-defined keywords.
- **Anti-Screenshot Defense**: Automatic screen blackout for 2.5 seconds when PrintScreen or screen capture shortcuts are initiated.
- **Security PIN Lock**: 4-digit PIN barrier protecting the extension dashboard from unauthorized modifications.
